units.source_text: 八幡干事让对弈双方看过封纸之后，打开了信封的封口，取出棋谱，

en.t: After Secretary Yahata had shown the sealed paper to both players, he opened the envelope and took out the game record,

units.source_text: 一边在棋盘上摆子，一边在棋谱上寻找黑121封子，竟没有找到。

en.t: placing the stones on the board while searching the record for Black's sealed move at move 121, but he could not find it.
